name: bow
description: The play bow found with the pose editor, played from the stand: all four legs at once (front legs squatted with the shoulders 75 and the knees -50, back legs extended with the shoulders 10 and the knees -45, the claw closed and the arm down at its stand angle), at the stand-up's pace, held a moment, then back to the stand. Played with `g2script bow --amount 1.0`: the run stands him up from rest with the eased stand-up first and lays him in rest after.
